ExpressLRS-Funkstatus: LQ, RSSI je Anten: ExpressLRS link status: LQ, RSSI per antenna, SNR, power, packet rate and warnings.
Freestyle-Punkte am Sender und ein Sessi: Freestyle points on the radio and a session debrief after disarming.
Schreibt während des Flugs eine kleine C: Writes a small CSV file during the flight – read it out without a blackbox cable.
Nutzt das Gyro der TX15: Sender kippen l: Uses the TX15's gyro: tilting the radio triggers callouts or steers a camera.
VTX-Band, Kanal, Leistung und Betaflight: Switch VTX band, channel, power and Betaflight profiles by touch.
Liest die Empfangsstärke des Quads (1RSS: Reads the quad's signal strength (1RSS/2RSS in dBm, plus RQly), smooths it and shows it as a bar with a peak marker.
Im Vollbild piept es wie ein Geigerzähle: In full screen it beeps like a Geiger counter: the stronger the signal, the faster and higher. HEISS (hot) means you are getting closer, KALT (cold) that you are moving away.
Merkt sich laufend die letzte gültige Po: Keeps track of the last valid position (GPS, altitude, speed, satellites). If the link drops or the battery dies, the display freezes that position, vibrates briefly and saves it to the SD card – it even survives a restart of the radio.
Das Widget zeichnet einen QR-Code direkt: The widget draws a QR code right on the display. Point your phone camera at it and the position opens in Google Maps or Apple Maps.
Liest die Akkuspannung (RxBt bei Express: Reads the battery voltage (RxBt with ExpressLRS, otherwise VFAS or a chosen source) and detects the cell count by itself when you plug in.
Zeigt die Spannung pro Zelle, den Sag (E: Shows the voltage per cell, the sag (drop compared to resting voltage) live and as a maximum, the lowest cell and the remaining capacity from the current sensor, from Bat% or estimated from voltage. Optionally it calls out a low resting voltage.
Zeigt Link-Qualität, RSSI beider Empfäng: Shows link quality, RSSI of both receiver antennas, SNR, the power currently transmitted (dynamic power) and the packet rate, plus the LQ history of the last minute and the session lows.
Warnt früh, bevor der Failsafe greift: w: Warns early, before failsafe kicks in: when one antenna is consistently much weaker (damaged or badly routed), when LQ or RSSI get low, or when the radio is already at full power.
Rechnet aus der Lage-Telemetrie von Beta: Computes rotation rates from Betaflight's attitude telemetry (Ptch, Roll, Yaw), detects flips, rolls and yaw spins and counts flight time. After disarming, the debrief shows score, top flip rate and flight time; every session is also saved to /LOGS/fsscore.csv.
Die Telemetrie kommt viel seltener als d: Telemetry arrives far less often than blackbox data, so the values are estimates. For exact scoring there is the Blackbox Viewer with leaderboard and duels. Betaflight does not send G-forces over CRSF.
Solange der Schalter aktiv ist, schreibt: While the switch is active, the script writes five lines per second to /LOGS/TLM_<date>_<time>.csv: battery, current, consumption, link values, altitude, speed, GPS position, attitude and throttle.
Die Datei liest du später per USB am PC: Read the file later on your PC via USB. The Lat and Lon columns can be loaded straight into map services, for example as a heatmap. If a sensor is missing, its column stays empty.
Wertet die Neigung des Senders aus und l: Evaluates the radio's tilt and provides two new sources for the mixer: Cam is the smoothed tilt, e.g. for the camera angle in an FPV simulator. Kipp jumps to +100 % while the radio is tilted past the threshold – use it to trigger logical switches and special functions.
Mit Ansage = 1 sagt der Sender beim Nach: With Ansage = 1 the radio calls out battery voltage and LQ when you tilt it forward.
Liest die aktuelle VTX-Einstellung vom F: Reads the current VTX setting from the flight controller and changes band, channel, power and pit mode with buttons on the touchscreen – no stick combos in the OSD. The power levels carry the names from the VTX table. Extra buttons switch the PID or rate profile directly.
Die Befehle gehen als MSP über CRSF zum: The commands travel to the flight controller as MSP over CRSF, like the official Betaflight Lua script. Channels outside 5725–5875 MHz (allowed in Switzerland and the EU at up to 25 mW) are shown in orange.
Im ExpressLRS-Lua die Sendeleistung fest: In the ExpressLRS Lua, set the output power to a fixed 10–25 mW and turn off dynamic power. At full power the signal is strong everywhere.
Widget auf einer Hauptansicht einrichten: Set up the widget on a main view and switch to full screen to search – it only beeps there.

Widget auf einer Hauptansicht in einem g: Set up the widget on a main view in a large zone (e.g. full width). In a small zone the position is shown as text.

zuordnen und kalibrieren. Arm-Schalter u: map and calibrate it. Flip the arm switch with throttle down. Without a radio, use keyboard or gamepad – angle mode starts then. Acro is the default for radios.
P, I, D und Feedforward verwenden die Be: P, I, D and feedforward use Betaflight scaling (P × 0.032, I × 0.244, D × 0.00053). D acts on the gyro signal, not on the error, so there is no D kick. Press

Das Funksignal folgt der Freiraumdämpfun: The radio signal follows free-space loss at 5.8 GHz. Terrain, concrete and trees between the pilot at the launch pad and the copter add attenuation. Analog slowly fills with noise, digital drops abruptly with block artefacts and frozen frames.
